decision_origin: Direct user authored request on 2026-11-20: trusted advisor, smart business, AI and agentic, personally fixing/automating/robust scaling, simple understandable future-proof no person/vendor dependence, portal, training from basics to advanced, AI transformation and innovation implementation.
canonical_one_sentence: Ik help ondernemers en organisaties hun bedrijf slimmer, eenvoudiger en toekomstbestendiger te maken door bedrijfsproblemen praktisch op te lossen en software, AI, BI en data als één betrouwbaar intelligent geheel te ontwerpen.
audience_outcome: Rust, overzicht, regie, werkbare oplossingen en minder afhankelijkheid van personen of leveranciers.
role: Independent trusted advisor, hands-on technology and transformation lead, implementation and knowledge transfer partner; not a product pusher or generic AI agency.
independence: Use open interfaces, customer data ownership, documented decisions, replaceable components and model/tool choice when technically and contractually feasible. Never guarantee zero vendor lock-in.
differentiation: Start with a concrete human/entrepreneur problem; no solution looking for a problem
Translate complex choices into plain language and one next step
Diagnose root cause, fix, test, deploy through existing protected delivery
Combine software, data, business intelligence, AI and appropriate agentic workflows within one governed system
Build reliable recovery: monitoring, ownership, bounded automation, human review and reversibility
Hand over knowledge and train people, preventing key-person dependence
Use existing software where sensible; replace only if supported by evidence
Make changes measurable; separate expected benefit from realized effect
operating_sequence: show in plain language via portal

customer_portal.opening: Hoe staat mijn bedrijf ervoor, wat vraagt aandacht en wat gebeurt er nu?
five_plain_language_steps: Begrijpen: wat speelt er en waarom
Kiezen: wat levert een stap mogelijk op en welk risico heeft hij
Uitvoeren: wie of welke geautoriseerde agent doet wat
Bewijzen: wat is echt veranderd en wat is alleen verwacht
Borgen: hoe werkt dit door bij mensen, systemen en volgende stappen
ux_constraints: One clear next action per screen
Human-readable status and source/caveat for each material value
Never demo/sample data as customer reality
No hidden irreversible agent action or unsupported promises
Data, decisions and knowledge belong to client
Keep existing portal v2, ONE BRAIN/Powerhouse/Heartbeat chain and 86-capability model as source of truth

commercial_routes.principle: Show need → clarity → pragmatic implementation → adoption/skills → measured continuity; do not replace pricing or current contracts silently.
commercial_routes.pricing_rule: Existing canvas price amounts are positioning research, not proven live prices; do not publish a new price unless publicly verified and approved.
commercial_routes.evidence_rule: Do not claim services/portal modules are in production until original owner approval, live route, authorization and actual readback.

personal_linkedin.objective: Demonstrate genuine earned trusted-advisor judgment through verified own decisions, tradeoffs, teaching/coaching facts, technology leadership and honest learning.
personal_linkedin.source_rule: One self-verified own event/decision first, external frictions as external context ONLY. Experience, customer outcomes, personally coded changes must be independently sourced.
personal_linkedin.tone: Ik, human, curious, professional, concrete; no sales CTA, forced question, repeated phrase, invented client scene, fake transformation results or generic motivational AI speech.
personal_linkedin.avoid: Do not cram every pillar, technology or training program into every post; one personally grounded point per post.

company_website.objective: Offer calm, plain language, outcomes-first trusted advice rather than technical capability catalog.
page_story: Hoe kan je team het straks zelf?
company_website.tone: Outcome-first, trustworthy, calm, no hype; exact evidence for price, effectiveness, capability and availability.

sales_training.objective: Offer scan/workshop and implementation/adoption as an integrated customer path, not five speculative SaaS capabilities.
sales_training.proof: Each outcome has owner, baseline, acceptance, provider-reported proof and transfer; no placeholder as success.

metrics.never: invent ROI, adoption, satisfaction, live project, trained client or agent autonomy

principles_of_agentic_ai: Autonomy is conditional on risk and authorization
agents recommend or act only within delegated explicit scopes
human escalation for material irreversible actions
idempotency, replay, observation, tests, rollback, audit
safe failure and continued recovery not silent stop
portable data and composable model/tool choices where possible
